name: Melmetal

abilities.name: Metal Scrum
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in play, all of your {Metal} Pokémon take −20 damage from attacks from your opponent’s Pokémon. This effect doesn’t stack.

flavor:
At the end of its life-span, Melmetal will rust and
fall apart. The small shards left behind will
eventually be reborn as Meltan.
